frozenFiles.note: 2026-09-20 daemon v2.1.1 hotfix: remove the 600-second total download ceiling so transfers that keep receiving bytes can complete on slow links. Keep the 15-second connection timeout, bound waiting for response headers to 2 minutes, and abort bodies after 2 minutes without data. Streaming, progress callbacks, endpoints, asset names, HTTP error handling and checksum verification remain unchanged. ReleaseClientDownloadTest verifies continued progress across multiple timeout windows and stalled/late response cancellation.

2026-09-11 observability: add bounded upgrade diagnostics and a post-switch receipt; preserve CLI symlink resolution, asset names, checksums, install paths, version switching and service identity. 2026-09-14 #364: recognize Homebrew/Scoop layouts and emit their upgrade commands only on the matching host OS; a managed layout still takes priority and unrecognized layouts get the host installer one-liner. Stable asset names, checksum validation, install paths, service identity, executable names, package-manager package ids and legacy CLI commands remain unchanged. UpdateServiceTest covers host-scoped classification and cross-platform command rejection; reviewed third-batch change. 2026-09-14 #381-A: apply accepts an optional phase/download-progress listener (default quiet; listener exceptions are swallowed) rendered by the update CLI on stderr and kept silent for background auto-update. Asset names, checksum validation, temp-dir cleanup, install paths, version switching, service identity, executable names and legacy CLI commands remain unchanged. UpdateProgressTest covers terminal and redirected output plus checksum/HTTP failure without switching the launcher.

2026-09-11 observability: optional diagnostic context and connection IDs; capability defaults false. Existing wire names, identity and E2E payload semantics preserved; DiagnosticWireCompatTest covers older peers and malformed metadata. 2026-09-13 #376: append nullable SessionLive.notice with a null default; null is omitted and legacy clients ignore the optional informational field. Existing frame names, lifecycle fields, identity and E2E semantics remain unchanged. SessionNoticeWireCompatTest covers legacy decoding and null omission; independent wire review passed. 2026-09-14 #362: append trailing optional DaemonInfo.supportsProjectPins and ClientCaps.supportsProjectPins, both defaulting to false; project pin frames live in ProjectPins.kt and are never sent to a peer that did not advertise the capability. Existing identity, key derivation, frame names, default behavior and E2E semantics remain unchanged. ProjectPinsWireCompatTest covers absent-capability decoding both ways, unknown pin frames and unknown keys; independent additive wire review passed. 2026-09-14 #360 phase two: append trailing optional ClientCaps.supportsManagedSessions (false), DaemonInfo.supportsManagedSessions (false) and DaemonInfo.managedAgents (empty); managed session frames live in ManagedSessions.kt and are never sent to a peer that did not advertise the capability. ListSessions/Sessions shapes, existing frame names, identity and E2E semantics remain unchanged. ManagedSessionsWireCompatTest covers absent-capability decoding both ways, legacy list shape, unknown managed frames, enums, keys and missing/unknown agents (never read as Claude); frames are paged under a 3 MiB encoded byte budget. Independent wire re-review: compatible; security review fixes applied. 2026-09-15 #380 live folding: append trailing optional ToolEvent.outcomeOnly (false) and ClientCaps.supportsToolOutcomes (false); a bare outcome RESULT for an ordinary tool is emitted only to a connection that advertised the capability, so undeclared peers keep the START-only stream. Existing frame names, identity, key derivation and E2E semantics remain unchanged. SerializationRoundTripTest covers legacy decoding both ways and the old-client concrete serializer; RequestRouterToolOutcomesTest covers the per-connection gate. 2026-09-19 #389: append optional RegisterPush.requestId (null, omitted for legacy peers), PROTO_V_PUSH_ACK=5 and the opt-in PushRegistrationResult receipt. The relay acknowledges only requests carrying a request ID; clients wait for receipts only after relay protocol capability negotiation. Legacy registration frames, identity, key derivation and E2E semantics are preserved. Push registration wire compatibility and relay ACK tests cover legacy silence, capability negotiation, stored/cleared/error receipts and stale-connection fencing. 2026-09-22 #394/#396: append defaulted SessionLive.contextUsedAuthoritative, SessionLive.compactSummary and HistoryMessage.compactSummary. Existing discriminators, request shapes, routes, package identities and E2E remain unchanged. Old clients ignore the new fields without interpreting compact summaries as output receipts; old daemons retain seed-only context semantics. CompactWireCompatTest and SerializationRoundTripTest cover old defaults, null omission, new/old shapes and Envelope round trips. Dedicated protocol compatibility review completed.
